ACT NO. 10 OF 1982
[Commencement: See Section (1)]
ACT
To provide for the levying of Customs, Excise and Sales Du­
ties and surcharge, the prohibition and control of the importation,
export or manufacture of certain goods and for matters incident­
al thereto and connected therewith.

and shall be deemed to have come into force on the first day of
September, 1969.
